title: Bound chart-118 pivot635 pairing under the fixed paid itinerary
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The comparison is to independently reproduced #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

This excludes all 81 frozen chart-118 public-bank keys for pivot 635 on the current fixed-paid 3→127 cohort. Seven keys reuse authenticated full-rank exterior prefix evidence from #7359. The other 74 have nonzero exact rational prefix and suffix support but both local and endpoint pairings vanish. One engine checks all 74 directly. The independent engine checks two representative banks and proves the 73-key first class by literal invertible internal ADD and SCALE contacts. The 14-role bank at cut 40853 follows a paid egress and receives its own proof. Both methods agree on every new case. The frozen scope is exhausted.

A hypothetical 17-copy productive 5+4 split leaves 110,519 paid positions fixed and raises productive positions to 22,478. Its optimistic upper is about 0.380712103178622 raw. One extra paid rank-one position would erase the price advantage. The exact pairing obstruction prevents a build in this scope.

## Task and overlap

This refines #7359's exact current-word bank inventory by certifying its chart-118 modular survivors. It fixes the chart, pivot, original paid itinerary and original endpoint cohort. #7112's pivot 631 remains a distinct construction inherited by #7113. Canonical main was `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` at pre-submit refresh.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-chart118-pivot635-pairing-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay regenerates seven receipts, authenticates the #7359 coverage and rejects three altered inputs. The original #7110 pivot-635 witness supplies a positive pairing control. Its old suffix includes a coefficient outside the current cohort, and its full historical candidate remains local-only. The research commit adds one package and uses the two existing #7257 CI fixes for the historical selected replay gap documented in #7371. The selected record is unchanged.

## Credit

#7359 supplies the bank inventory and paired engines. #7112 and #7113 supply the inherited chart-118 construction and signed caller. #7334 supplies the current word. #7298 supplies the directed tariff. The historical pivot-635 control is recorded in #7111. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A changed retirement, paid route or guarded temporal response needs a separate complete price and exact proof. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
